english_text: being darkened in their understanding, alienated from the life of God, because of the ignorance that is in them, because of the hardening of their hearts;
english:
When people are closed off to new ideas, their understanding becomes clouded.
This isolation prevents them from experiencing the richness of life.
Ignorance and a hardened heart keep them trapped in a limited perspective.
spanish:
Cuando las personas se cierran a nuevas ideas, su comprensión se vuelve nublada.
Este aislamiento les impide experimentar la riqueza de la vida.
La ignorancia y un corazón endurecido los mantienen atrapados en una perspectiva limitada.
portuguese:
Quando as pessoas se fecham para novas ideias, sua compreensão fica turva.
Esse isolamento impede que experimentem a riqueza da vida.
A ignorância e um coração endurecido os mantêm presos a uma perspectiva limitada.
french:
Lorsque les gens se ferment aux nouvelles idées, leur compréhension devient trouble.
Cet isolement les empêche de vivre la richesse de la vie.
L'ignorance et un cœur endurci les maintiennent enfermés dans une perspective limitée.
tagalog:
Kapag ang mga tao ay nagsasara sa mga bagong ideya, nagiging malabo ang kanilang pag-unawa.
Pinipigilan ng pag-iisa na ito ang kanilang maranasan ang kasaganaan ng buhay.
Ang kamangmangan at matigas na puso ay nag-iiwan sa kanila sa isang limitadong pananaw.
swahili:
Wakati watu wanajifunga kwa mawazo mapya, uelewa wao huwa na ukungu.
Ujinga huu unaowazuia kufurahia utajiri wa maisha.
Ujinga na moyo uliokolea huwazuia kuona kwa upana.
mandarin_chinese:
当人们对新想法关闭时，他们的理解会变得模糊。
这种隔离阻止他们体验生活的丰富。
无知和僵硬的心让他们陷入狭隘的视角。
russian:
Когда люди закрываются от новых идей, их понимание становится мутным.
Это изоляция мешает им ощутить богатство жизни.
Невежество и ожесточённое сердце удерживают их в ограниченной перспективе.
malayalam:
പുതിയ ആശയങ്ങളോട് അടച്ചുപൂട്ടുമ്പോൾ, ആളുകളുടെ ബോധം മങ്ങുന്നു.
ഈ ഏകാന്തത അവരെ ജീവിതത്തിന്റെ സമ്പന്നത അനുഭവിക്കാൻ തടയുന്നു.
അജ്ഞതയും കഠിനമായ ഹൃദയവും അവരെ പരിമിതമായ കാഴ്ചപ്പാടിൽ കുടുക്കുന്നു.
